title: Test Movie renders completely black — all content invisible despite SWF loading without Ruffle errors
description:
After recent import fixes (0885, 0890, 0901, 0902 all fixed), Magnet.fla now imports correctly (6 layers, 53 frames, real content in scene AA). However Test Movie still renders a completely black player canvas.

Observed in QA run 6 (2026-06-10):
- Console: ZERO Ruffle errors or warnings (DefineShape4 fix working, JPEG EOI fix working, readCPicSwf fix working)
- Output tab: "New Ruffle instance created ... Loading SWF file blob:..." only — no errors
- Screen: Solid black, 0% visible content
- Duration: Black for 10+ seconds, no preloader progress visible
- Interaction: Click, Enter, Space, Arrow keys produce no visual change
- The SWF loads silently; Ruffle does not log any shape/fill/bitmap errors

Import state (from doc_summary):
- Scene AA (first scene): 6 layers (Layer 7, Layer 3, M Layer 5, Magnets, Walls), 53 frames
- Magnets layer has AS2 scripts on every keyframe
- Library: 25 bitmaps, 62 symbols, 4 sounds

Possible causes (for fix team, not QA):
- JPEG bitmap pixel data may be all-black (EOI fix added the marker but underlying pixel data may still be wrong)
- SetBackgroundColor SWF tag may be emitted as black
- All vector shapes may now have valid-but-black fill styles after the 0890 fix
- Layer depth ordering may place a black overlay on top of all content

Screenshots: test-movie-run6.png, test-movie-run6e.png (both show solid black)
